info.title: sCalenderPlus API
info.description: Public REST API of sCalenderPlus. See docs/architecture/api.md.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up (no dependency checks).
Readiness: database reachable and migrated (worker: job loop heartbeat).

post.description: Always answers 202 for a well-formed request with an allowed email domain (disposable-email providers: 422 email_domain_not_allowed): a new account gets a confirmation email, an already registered address gets a hint email instead (no user enumeration). Sign in afterwards with POST /auth/login.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Sets the session cookie, or answers twoFactorRequired (second step: POST /auth/login/2fa). Failures are 401 invalid_credentials; after 5 failures in a row the account is locked for 15 minutes (still answered as invalid_credentials).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Second login step: authenticator code or recovery code
post.description: Needs the pending-login cookie from POST /auth/login (twoFactorRequired, valid 5 minutes); without it 401 unauthenticated. Wrong codes are 401 invalid_credentials and count towards the lockout; each recovery code works once.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: End the session (clears the session cookie)

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Set a new password with the token from the reset link
post.description: Also confirms the email address (the link proved ownership), lifts a lockout and ends all other sessions.

patch.summary: Update profile settings (JSON Merge Patch, requires If-Match)
patch.description: Absent or null members stay unchanged. Unknown time zones are 422 time_zone_invalid, unsupported locales and week starts 400 validation_failed. If-Match: the ETag of GET /me (or *); missing → 428 precondition_required, stale → 412 precondition_failed.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).
Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.description: Ordered by creation. limit: 1–200 (default 50); cursor: nextCursor of the previous page.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Create a group (the caller becomes owner and billing owner)

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.summary: A group I am a member of (with ETag)
get.description: 404 for groups the caller is not a member of (no existence leaks).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

patch.summary: Rename or change settings (admins and owners; JSON Merge Patch, requires If-Match)
patch.description: Absent or null members stay unchanged; an empty description removes it. Members and viewers: 403 insufficient_permission. If-Match: the ETag of GET /groups/{id} (or *).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

delete.summary: Delete the group with its memberships and invites (owners only, requires If-Match)

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.description: Every member sees the list unless memberListVisibility is members_and_above (viewers: 403). Emails are only shown to admins and owners.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

patch.description: Owners assign any role; admins manage members and viewers only and assign at most member (only owners promote to admin or owner); everyone may lower their own role. The last owner cannot be demoted (409 last_owner), the billing owner only after transferring billing (409 billing_owner_transfer_required); frozen groups refuse role changes (409 group_frozen). revokeEventShares (default true): on demotion also revoke the member's individual event shares on the group's calendars.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

delete.summary: Remove a member, or leave the group with your own user id (requires If-Match)
delete.description: Owners remove anyone, admins members and viewers; everyone may leave. Last-owner and billing-owner protection as for role changes. revokeEventShares (default true): also revoke the member's individual event shares on the group's calendars.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Make another owner the billing owner (billing owner only)
post.description: The recipient must be a member with role owner (409 billing_owner_must_be_owner); their plan governs the group from now on.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Invite by email or create an invite link (admins and owners)
post.description: With email: a single-use invite sent to that address (en/de), usable only by an account whose verified email matches; a new invite replaces pending ones for the address. Without email: an invite link (role at most member, maxUses 1–1000, default 50) returned once in url. role: owners invite any role, admins up to member. expiresInDays: 1–30 (default 14 for email, 7 for links). Frozen groups: 409 group_frozen.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.summary: Pending invites of a group (admins and owners, cursor-paginated)

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

delete.summary: Revoke an invite (admins and owners; idempotent)
delete.description: Admins can revoke invites with roles up to member. Revoking an expired, used or revoked invite is a no-op.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Join a group with an invite token
post.description: Needs a verified email address (403 email_not_verified); email invites only for the invited address (403 invite_email_mismatch). Unknown, expired, revoked and used-up tokens are 400 token_invalid alike. Members accepting again keep their role. Returns the group.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code (part of the contract; never renamed).

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details. Further members depend on the code (e.g. `limit`, `required`, `actual`).

session.description: Session cookie set by POST /api/v1/auth/login (web app, same origin). Unsafe methods also need the header `X-Requested-With: scal`.
